title: Certify selected COPY separation in every odd address characteristic
body:
The existing operator-intertwiner lemma leaves open which actual selected COPY maps are equal; PR2088 provides nine distinct rational maps. This independent audit reconstructs those maps without importing predecessor executable code, supplies a dyadic-unit separating witness for all 36 pairs, and proves that they remain distinct over every odd-characteristic address field.

Applying the credited intertwiner lemma then permits only `U=V=I` for simultaneous scalar helper/snapshot rebasing with those maps fixed, on any subset of the nine roles. Boolean function coefficients remain in F2 while addresses range over the odd-characteristic field. This does not reject PR1704/2088's temporary snapshot mixing, which restores its net map before ERASE.

Validation: exact RREF-normal and separate Gram-Schmidt projectors agree with every pinned PR2088 map; all36 unit witnesses pass; a literal F3 Boolean-function checker tests36 GL2 pairs on16 dirty-function pairs for each map pair. Four controls include characteristic-three collapse of a merely rational separation. Registered CPython3.12.7 ordinary/optimized replay and a separate subagent proof/code review pass. Reproduce with `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-selected-copy-separation`.

Scope: one source-bound interface audit, no new physical COPY implementation, recursive profile, supplier admission or kappa. The README records native/common-chart premises and unrun compiler, scratch, hosting and outer obligations. Exact predecessor heads/Git blobs/SHA256, current-main task selection, scope change, live overlap and Open next questions are included. Credit Adam Gall/PR2088, woklerx's abstract intertwiner, Ross Richardson/PR1704 and the retained PR1627/1943/1062/589/555 lineage. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0, no independent human review claimed.
